environment.description: Node.js 20 application deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with default parameter group. The application connects to RDS using a master credential with full privileges on the 'assets' schema. Security groups allow inbound on port 3000 from the ELB only. No additional middleware or proxy layers between ELB and application.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP listener on port 443 forwarding to port 3000
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, db.r6g.large, default parameter group, no pgaudit
config.db_user_privileges: GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO app_user
config.network: VPC with public subnet for ELB, private subnet for EC2 and RDS
